propositions: Overlap judge batch calls inherit generic 16,000-token / 600-second budgets and permit three structured generations and four transport retries, causing malformed responses to consume 200+ seconds before safe abstention

judge_batch constructs RunRequest without operation-local output, structured-retry, transport-attempt, or timeout bounds, violating story 9022 and ADR 0086 requirement for bounded advisory classification with prompt timeout/error/malformed degradation

Token-only output caps and schema validation alone are insufficient to contain latency; all four bounds (output tokens, structured retries, transport attempts, elapsed timeout) must be lowered before model/provider construction

Repair applies request-local seams to RunRequest and _effective_config, explicitly capping overlap calls to 1,024 output tokens, one structured attempt, one transport attempt, and 60-second timeout, degrading any bound hit to exact all-candidate abstention
Valid batched verdicts retain label-keyed mapping and aggregation behavior; existing callers omitting request-local limits retain prior defaults
Original-path replication confirms malformed responses now abstain within declared bounds without fabricating overlaps, reducing failure latency from 200+ seconds to 10–22 seconds
